SELECT jp.job_posting_id, jp.title, jp.work_region, jp.career_type, jp.employment_type, jc.category_name, c.company_name, c.logo_url
FROM job_postings jp
INNER JOIN companies c ON jp.company_id = c.company_id
INNER JOIN job_categories jc ON jp.job_category_id = jc.job_category_id
WHERE jp.status = '모집중'
ORDER BY jp.published_at DESC LIMIT 6;

SELECT jp.job_posting_id, jp.title, jp.work_region, jp.career_type, jp.employment_type, jc.category_name, c.company_name, c.logo_url
FROM job_postings jp
INNER JOIN companies c ON jp.company_id = c.company_id
INNER JOIN job_categories jc ON jp.job_category_id = jc.job_category_id
WHERE jp.status = '모집중'
ORDER BY jp.view_count DESC LIMIT 6;
